snippet.title: Auto Blobber - Announcement Trailer | 2D Pixel Art Auto-Battler
snippet.description:
Welcome to AutoBlobber, where your strategic Blob skills will be put to the ultimate test! 

In AutoBlobber, strategy is everything. Carefully place upgrades between waves, evolve your Blob with powerful enchantments, and fight through relentless enemy swarms. How long can you survive?

🏆Climb the global leaderboard and prove your skills!
💥 Upgrade, adapt, and battle through endless waves!
⚔️ Face off against unique enemies and powerful bosses!

Think you have what it takes? Test your strategy in AutoBlobber!
Release Date: 2025



✨Wishlist AutoBlobber on Steam now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3240250/AutoBlobber/
🕹️🔧Interested in Playtesting?  Please Join Our Discord server for more Information and Updates! - https://discord.gg/w2BNAzBzAj 



Credits:
Music composed by Bert Cole - https://bitbybitsound.com
Font made by Gabriel Cortabraz - https://oworowo.itch.io/mini-pixel-font
